snippet.title: Nomori | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Nomori now on Steam and Xbox: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932680/Nomori/
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/nomori/9n1xgrnj51mc

Grab the launch discount while you can.

Nomori is a gorgeous and heartfelt adventure puzzle game that puts the power of time and space in your hands. As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. 

Our labor of Love.

Now for you to experience.

We hope you enjoy your time with Kiko and Yuki.

Please keep sharing your playthroughs and thoughts as you play.

Join our discord: https://discord.gg/mXyXRC6twP
